verdict.rationale: Jira documents assigning work to coding agents, so agentic code workflows are a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no capability to review agent code diffs, comment on specific lines, do so from a mobile app, or have the agent iterate on that feedback. Agent assignment and viewing development status are adjacent features, not line-level code review.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
